title: A Dialectics of Jazz
line: Adorno despised jazz and wrote about it at length. I am a jazz musician who made jazz machine-computable and met the institutional pushback that followed. The essay takes his argument seriously enough to say which part of it lands.
needs: Reading. The argument is mine to make before it is written.

title: The Register as an Observation Operator
line: What the imperial print register of British Punjab can and cannot be asked, and why the apparatus that recorded a population is one of the objects of study rather than a window onto it.
needs: The corpus is published. This is the argument that the data was built to support.

title: Silicon Valley Empires
line: Whether the platform firm is an empire in more than metaphor — and what the comparison licenses once the resemblance can be tested rather than asserted.
needs: A working computational model of empire. Until the comparison is checkable, this is an essay that would only sound true.
